my view: AGI is meaningful, but not close.


Grady Booch (@Grady_Booch)

Here is my prediction:

The Magnificent Seven  - Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Tesla  - will continue to push AI down our throats despite diminishing returns to its users, simply because they’ve invested so much they’ve gone past a point of no return.

That notwithstanding, the inevitable Great Implosion will happen to companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI  be

Holy smokes! Opus 4.6 set a new record on the Remote Labor Index!

At 4.17%. 

Anyone who claims that we are close to AGI is either lying or lost.

Tesla robotaxis are sometimes driven remotely, by humans.

They just admitted it.

Read the book that anticipated neurosymbolic AI (which afaik underlies everything from AlphaGeometry to Claude Code) 25 years ago.


AI_4_Healthcare (@AI_4_Healthcare)

Everywhere I turn, more AI sages and a modern Godfather of AI (or two) are pushing neuro-symbolic AI as the next frontier in LLMs and GenAI evolution.

Time for @GaryMarcus to order a reprint of The Algebraic Mind from 2001 with a new, one-sentence, author foreword to read ...

 "I 🤬ing told you so!"  😉

amazon.com/Algebraic-Mind

live by the sword, die by the sword.


Gergely Orosz (@GergelyOrosz)

This is either brilliant or scary:

Anthropic accidentally leaked the TS source code of Claude Code (which is closed source). Repos sharing the source are taken down with DMCA.

BUT this repo rewrote the code using Python, and so it violates no copyright & cannot be taken down!





— https://nitter.net/GergelyOrosz/status/2038985760175505491#m

Correct


Saffron Warlord (@rawantitmc)

AGI is not possible without extremely mature neurosymbolic architecture



— https://nitter.net/rawantitmc/status/2038825535552569718#m

A lot of receipts, going back to 1989 are here, for those interested in facts:

open.substack.com/pub/garyma…

yes, it does.


RedmixGeco (@RedmixGeco)

LeCun's pattern dates back to his 1989 convolutional net paper, echoing Fukushima's earlier neocognitron without citation. Media chases AGI headlines, not dusty footnotes. Astonishing? Or just the usual Nobel-adjacent rewrite?



— https://nitter.net/RedmixGeco/status/2038997240660832478#m

Over and over and over LeCun borrows other people’s ideas and makes them sound like his own. 

It’s astonishing that the media never investigates, when the pattern has been so consistent for decades.


Jürgen Schmidhuber (@SchmidhuberAI)

Dr. LeCun's heavily promoted Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA, 2022) [5] is the heart of his new company. However, the core ideas are not original to LeCun. Instead, JEPA is essentially identical to our 1992 Predictability Maximization system (PMAX

2025 was all about how OpenAI was supposedly about to achieve AGI.

2026 is all about how Anthropic is supposedly about to achieve AGI.

2027 will be all about how Google is supposedly about to achieve AGI.

Rinse, lather, repeat.

amazing. i was giving examples like this for DALL-E three years ago. 

systems are still struggling with some basics.


Javier Ideami (@ideami)

Before AI solves ARC-AGI3, it could warm up by solving this: "9 cubes, 4 are red, 3 are green and 2 are blue. The green cubes are on top of the red cubes and the red cubes are on top of the blue cubes" results from latest ChatGPT, Gemini and Flux Context Pro @fchollet @GaryMarcus









— https://nitter.net/ideami/status/2038715901730574711#m
*”can’t see” was too strong. there is a deep problem here but i regret that phrasing.
